pro_course_detail.title: US English Pronunciation Assessment & Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Conquer US English Pronunciation: Dive Deep with Phoneme Assessment & Coaching

Struggling with specific American sounds? Get laser-focused with this custom phoneme assessment & coaching sessions.

Here's how we unlock your fluency:

Deep Dive: Analyze all 46 US English phonemes, testing production in initial, medial, and final positions for consonants, both stressed and unstressed for vowels.

Actionable Insights: Beyond generic algorithms, your dedicated coach pinpoints your exact problem areas and tailors practice to tackle them head-on.

Master Mouth Muscle: Receive detailed feedback on tongue placement, mouth shape, and tension for each challenging sound.

Personalized Study Plan: Get a clear roadmap with targeted exercises and resources to keep you crushing those tricky phonemes.

Visual Dashboard: Access a user-friendly Google Sheets dashboard to track your progress, problem areas, and recommended practice for each phoneme.

Time Investment:

Assessment Only (60 minutes): Ideal for identifying your pronunciation hurdles. Includes minimal notes and no coaching.

Targeted Coaching Sessions (30 minutes): Focus on mastering 1-2 specific phonemes, perfecting those tricky sounds one by one. Prerequisite: Completed Assessment. 

Ready to unleash your pronunciation potential? Book your assessment today and take the first step to mastering US English pronunciation!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English Master - Speak Confidently in Professional Settings!
pro_course_detail.description:
In this Business English course, you will learn the essential vocabulary, phrases, and skills needed to excel in the workplace. 

This course is designed to make you feel confident and professional whether you are preparing for meetings, presentations, or just want to feel more at ease using English in business contexts. 

Business English Focus

In each lesson, you will dive into practical topics relevant to today’s professional world. 

Here are some topics we may cover:

- Meetings and Presentations: Learn how to present your ideas clearly and confidently, and pick up the language used in professional discussions.

- Cross-Cultural Communication: Master phrases and strategies for communicating with colleagues from different backgrounds, making sure your message is clear and respectful.

- Advertising and Marketing: Explore terms and techniques used in marketing, branding, and customer engagement, essential for business professionals.

- Business Email Writing: Get hands-on practice with writing professional emails that are polite, effective, and to-the-point.

- Business Technology Trends: Learn the language of technology in business, from digital tools to the latest tech developments.

Course Format

Each lesson is designed to be engaging and interactive. You will work through PDFs, audio clips, and video materials to practice speaking, listening, writing, and vocabulary. 

We can hold our lessons on whatever platform you prefer; Skype, italki Classroom, Google Meets or Zoom. 

Lessons are tailored to your specific needs, so whether you’re just starting out in business English or looking to refine your skills, I’m here to help you succeed.

Let’s start building your confidence in Business English! Book a lesson today and start speaking like a professional!

Please Note:
- Lessons are for students ages 16 years old and up.
- Please use a laptop or computer. It is impossible to do the lessons on a phone.

pro_course_detail.title: Legal English Course for Lawyers & Law Students
pro_course_detail.description:
Unlock the language of law with our engaging Legal English course, specifically designed for lawyers, law students, and legal professionals at the intermediate level. This course is tailored to help you confidently communicate in English within the fields of American and British Common Law.

In this course you will build essential vocabulary and understanding of legal concepts. We cover areas such as contracts, criminal law, and intellectual property. Each lesson is carefully designed and structured to introduce you to legal terminology and communication whether you are preparing for work with international clients and colleagues or simply want to refine your Legal English. 

Course Focus:

Speaking and Conversation: Through real-world scenarios and lively discussions, you will develop fluency and confidence in discussing legal topics. We will focus on role-playing common legal interactions, client consultations, debates and mock court arguments to make learning interactive and practical.
  
- Grammar and Listening Practice: Learn the structures and forms most common in legal writing and speaking. We’ll work on mastering grammar to ensure clarity and precision, which are critical in legal language.
  
- Legal Writing Instruction and Practice: For those interested in refining their Legal English writing skills, we will offer guidance on drafting contracts, legal opinions, and formal emails. You’ll learn how to convey complex ideas with accuracy and professionalism.

Why This Course?

This course not only improves your Legal English but also sharpens your critical thinking and persuasive speaking. Together, we’ll explore contemporary cases and topics that bring excitement to each session. Join us to expand your English skills and deepen your knowledge of the legal world. Get ready for a challenging, fun, and rewarding learning experience! 

Let’s start speaking Legal English confidently—book your first lesson today!

pro_course_detail.title: Read an article & discuss it with me!
pro_course_detail.description:
Objective: To improve reading skills, pronunciation, and comprehension through reading and discussing news articles.

Website: https://newsforkids.net/ (for A2-B1 students), https://www.npr.org/ (for B1-C2 students) or https://commonlit.org/en

Introduction: Welcome to the "Read an Article" lesson! In this lesson, you will have the opportunity to practice your reading skills, expand your vocabulary, and improve your pronunciation. 

Step 1: Article Selection
For A2-B1 students, we will be using the website https://newsforkids.net/ which provides interesting and age-appropriate news articles. B1-C2 students will have access to https://newsela.com/, a platform that offers articles at various reading levels to suit your proficiency. Select an article that interests you and make sure it is appropriate for your language level.

Step 2: Reading and Note-Taking
During the lesson, you will read the chosen article aloud while I listen attentively. As you read, I will type comments on Skype or in a shared document. These notes will help me identify areas for improvement in your pronunciation and comprehension.

Step 3: Pronunciation Practice
After you finish reading the article, we will focus on pronunciation. We will work together to correct any mispronunciations and ensure that you pronounce words accurately. To aid in this process, I will use phonetic symbols (/ˈsɪmblz/) to explain the correct pronunciation.

→ I will also write corrections in chat while you speak, and I will make suggestions about pronunciation, word choice, and grammar. 

Choose to practice your English! (`･ω･´)9

pro_course_detail.title: Discuss a specific topic with my PowerPoints (improve your English with topic-based lessons!)
pro_course_detail.description:
This is something you can use with any language. It's best to focus on 1 topic with a tutor. It's important to really "exhaust" the topic. For example, if you talk about the weather, talk about everything about the weather. Prepare for the lesson by learning vocabulary related to the topic, and then you try to talk about it for the entire session. If you pick "weather," you would talk about the weather today, the weather tomorrow and yesterday, the weather on vacation, how it's normally in May or December, how it's normally in Europe, the weather where you live, etc., and by the end of the session, you'll be very good at this topic, and you'll be able to express yourself just like any other native speaker. 

You can use one of my PowerPoints below. They include warm-up questions, pictures, questions, dialogue for 2 people to read, vocabulary practice, reading, etc. 

For upper beginner (20+ PowerPoints available):

Likes & dislikes, holiday food, computers, playing sports, snacks, food trucks, cooking methods,, family, fruits and vegetables, jobs in school, small talk, traveling, restaurants, in the airport, friendship, in the library, clothes, school, life in America

For intermediate (70+ PowerPoints available):

Dating, being alone, parenting, types of pets, feelings, police, cookies, vegetarian, going to the supermarket, kitchen equipment,  telephones, shopping online, birthdays, weather forecasts, barber and hair salon, restaurants, amusement parks, games

For intermediate-advanced (30+ PowerPoints available)

Greek food, water sports, tennis, donating plasma, colorblind, tornadoes, milk, Internet providers, Christmas tree, living in cities, body language, stuntmen, cat/dog breeds, paper quilling, gambling,  bicycles, celebrities, the library, food in South America

For advanced (9 PowerPoints available):

Running, fermented food, antioxidants, arthritis, wisdom teeth, police body cameras, vow renewal, earthquakes, thesis defense

teacher_info.about_teacher:
📚 Teaching Experience
I’ve been teaching at universities for many years and also teach English online. 🎓💻

🏅 I am certified to teach Beginner through Advanced-level English, and I specialize in Business English courses as well. 💼✍️

🇯🇵 Currently, I teach English at a junior high school in Japan and stream free English lessons online for learners worldwide. 🌍📺

✨ What My Lessons Include
✅ Grammar lectures
🎥 Engaging videos
🎙️ Pronunciation corrections
🗣️ Conversation practice
...and much more to help you achieve your English goals!

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or want to learn more. Let’s learn together! 😊🌟
teacher_info.teaching_style:
✨ What to Expect in My Lessons

🎥 I use a variety of resources to make learning engaging, including YouTube videos, texting, blogs, and more.

💬 During our first lesson, we’ll discuss your goals, and I’ll design lessons around your hobbies and interests to make learning enjoyable and personalized.

🌟 Lesson Structure:

🗣️ Warm-up conversation to get you comfortable speaking
📚 Grammar lessons and interactive activities
📖 Homework is available upon request, and I can provide exams to track your progress and celebrate your achievements! 🎉

Let’s make learning English fun and effective! 😊🌍

teacher_info.about_teacher: Italki 2022 Statistics:  Shellwyn earned the title "Masterful Mentor"; her students come from 29 countries; and she taught for 31,920 minutes this year, landing her in the top 1% of all Italki teachers.   For Shellwyn, teaching is a vocation--helping others learn and grow is an extremely satisfying profession!  She has taught learners of all ages, abilities, and backgrounds, in both public and private schools.  Shellwyn earned her Doctorate in Education in 2009.  She began teaching English professionally in 2012 (soon after she moved to Brazil) and earned a post-doctorate in Applied Linguistics in 2014.  She also partners with universities on various educational projects.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Shellwyn crafts lessons tailored to each individual student.  Whether you are a beginner or advanced learner, or whether you need business, academic, or another kind of focus, she has the experience and skills to get the job done right.  Shellwyn teaches using a communicative methodology, with imbedded grammar and clear learning objectives for each lesson.  She recommends a 30 minute per day study habit, applying the 'slow drip' method, but this is adjustable according to the learner's needs.  Shellwyn believes in using clear communication to meet learning goals, and only asks that the student bring a positive attitude to the class.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have 4+ years of experience teaching English as a second language. I have taught in classrooms and online, in public schools and a private university in Japan, in groups and one-on-one. 

My favorite way to teach is one-on-one, because it is the most versatile and flexible learning experience. As a teacher, I am kind, patient, and friendly!

Many of my students have been learning English through textbooks in classrooms for many years, but are still not confident in their language skills. My role as a teacher is to help you build that confidence with each lesson. I am patient and encouraging -- I want you to feel comfortable speaking in English and I will help you get there. :)
teacher_info.teaching_style: I like to establish a friendly relationship with my students -- you should feel comfortable enough with me to speak freely, make mistakes and express your opinions. For my conversation classes, I like to keep the discussions natural and realistic in the same way that you would have a real-life conversation with a native speaker, rather than a formal, classroom-like experience.

course_info.trial_description: In the trial lesson, we will have a conversation to get to know each other and help me understand your needs as a student.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's Talk! 100% Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
How do you learn to speak a foreign language? Practice, practice, practice! The more you speak, the better you will become. My goal is to provide a fun and engaging environment for you to practice speaking with the guidance of a professional teacher.

Throughout the lesson, I will identify and correct any consistent errors and give you suggestions for more natural phrases to use. I will share a private document with you that will contain all vocabulary and phrases learned throughout the lessons. 

If you are an upper beginner or lower intermediate learner, I will speak slowly and clearly, and we will work on building your confidence, vocabulary, and fluency skills. 

If you are an upper intermediate or advanced learner, I will challenge you by speaking at a native or near-native speed and level, and I invite you to challenge yourself in each lesson to use phrases or new vocabulary that you may be unsure of.

You are encouraged to ask as many questions as you’d like throughout the lesson (Example: Can you repeat that phrase? What does that mean? How is my pronunciation? Can I use “______” in this context? What is the difference between “______” and “_______”?)

Please note: I do not offer classes for children at this time.
